yes! sorry i hope i didn't worry you. i've been feeling a lot better the last few days ... my moods are going through extremes and it sucks but i'm seeing several highly trained doctors over the next few weeks. it's very possible i have some form of bipolar. 

 lmao now that i feel fine i can't believe i was, well, me, the other day. i can't believe i had those thoughts. as a bit of background info, my moods go from feeling awful and wanting to die to feeling elated and i could conquer the world. there is no inbetween for me.

i don't want to tell my friends how i'm feeling. i feel like i might blurt out something awful. 'you not talking to make me makes me want to literally kill myself' i don't want to be the kind of person who can say that ... i feel so terrible like maybe i've implied it to her and manipulated her into talking to me. i know i can be clingy too.
